scope: Compiler host transport only; no kernel implementation or checker policy changes.

selection.entry: Explicit --session-products[-modules]-lean|ps native seed arguments; no legacy fallback.
selection.request: Six-element JSON array: [contract, target, representation, metadata, declarations, sourceMap].
selection.constraints: Uniform, declarations and sourceMap are JavaScript-only. Wasm retains the existing private wasm32 self-host ABI.

stateMachine: Prepare source once and retain the immutable prepared Lean value; send protocol-pinned prepared admissions.
Parent performs its selected fresh kernel check and validates provider identity/certification context before sending a product request or checked-only acknowledgement.
Native seed compares exact admissions, emits selected target stages once, and compares admissions again before responding.

When declarations are requested, the host checks actual source/runtime/target/export subjects and sends the shared bounded canonical portable writer request. The native seed validates the selected declaration profile and invokes the writer on the same prepared source.
Host requires exact portable/independent declaration bytes, expected protocol/phase/target/profile and field inventory, bounded output, EOF and successful child exit before returning any product.
The common builder independently reconstructs graph products, selected declarations and optional original-source maps before publication.

bounds.framing: Existing byte limits apply before fatal UTF-8 decoding and JSON parsing; the extra response is enabled only by explicit selected direct declarations.
bounds.requests: Initial selector <=4096 UTF-8 bytes at native decode; declaration wire <=1 MiB and output <=64 MiB through the shared portable request codec.
bounds.scope: Host command production and protocol responses are bounded. Native getLine allocation, CPU, memory and compiler-internal work are not proven bounded.

compatibility: Legacy two-phase TypeScript/check-only entrypoints and default frame policy are retained. Unknown direct protocol/targets/profiles/fields and extra frames reject; no fallback.
products: Public API/erasure fields are transmitted only for metadata or declaration requests; origin/generated-position fields only for metadata/map requests. The portable staged producer may still compute them internally.
remaining: Complete transcript/input closure and isolated authority broker
Global preservation, portable execution closure and extensive assurance
canonicalSuccessor: psc-checked-seed-products/2 provides explicit Canonical selection; version 1 never silently changes its private Wasm ABI.
